literal_meaning: কথা (talk) + বার্তা (message/news); conversation or manner of speaking
figurative_meaning_en: Elegance in speech; the charm of sentence construction
similar_in_english: You can tell a man by the cut of his jib
Actions speak louder than words (in reverse, focusing on speech)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথাবার্তা শুনে বুঝা যায় সে শিক্ষিত।
example_sentences_in_english: From his speech, one can tell he is educated.
A person's mindset is revealed through their manner of speaking.
note: The idiom emphasizes how speech reflects character, a common cultural observation in Bengali society.
